name: Kyodai ni Hazu Netsubyo
source:
Hot, hot, hot summer. They are spending their daily life at the dining table alone together.
They have grown accustomed to the sound of the basement door being hammered like the courtship of cicadas,
At the same time, an unidentified body is discovered at a crime scene.
A cheerful rookie and a tired detective set out in pursuit of the duo, who have fled the scene.

⋄The two men are on the run from the scene of the crime.

Not Siblings, but Fever
translation:
夏天，炎热，炎热，炎热。他们独自在餐桌上度过日常生活。
他们已经习惯了地下室门被敲打的声音，就像蝉求爱的声音，
与此同时，犯罪现场发现了一具身份不明的尸体。
一名快乐的新秀和一名疲惫的侦探出发追捕逃离现场的二人组。

⋄这两个人正在逃离犯罪现场。

不是兄弟姐妹，而是发烧
